injuries.name: Ryan Poehling
injuries.note: Based on Quenneville's timeline, it seems like Poehling could be back in action against the Kings on either Friday or Saturday. In five games this year, the 27-year-old Minnesota native notched one goal and one assist. Whenever Poehling is given the all-clear, he figures to jump into a bottom-six role that includes time on the penalty kill.

injuries.name: A.J. Greer
injuries.note: Greer suffered an upper-body injury in Sunday's 6-3 win over Ottawa. He will miss at least the next four games, starting with Tuesday's matchup against Vancouver, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return. Greer has four goals, six points, 23 shots on net and 36 hits in 13 appearances this season.

injuries.name: Erik Gustafsson
injuries.note: Gustafsson will miss at least the next three games, starting with Monday's matchup against Montreal, after landing on injured reserve. He suffered an upper-body injury in Saturday's 4-2 loss to Ottawa. Gustafsson has two goals, nine points, 16 shots on net and 16 blocked shots in 16 appearances this season.
